cheshunt.s1_head: Kitting the events trade of the Lea Valley
s1loc: Cheshunt sits in the Lea Valley events corridor in the Borough of Broxbourne. Cheshunt Park and Cedars Park host open-air shows and seasonal events, the Lee Valley White Water Centre at Waltham Cross runs a summer beer festival with live music, and Broxbourne Riverside on Nazeing Road works as a natural amphitheatre for outdoor cinema and staged productions. Hoddesdon Carnival fills the streets each summer, and the Cheshunt Christmas Market lights the town centre in December.

And the trade runs at every size in the Lea Valley.
